sn17.30:1.2: bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ khīnāsavo tassa pāhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokam antarāyāya vadāmīti || || 3
sn17.30:1.3: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn17.30:1.4: Kissa pana bhante khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno lābhasakkārasiloko antarāyāyāti || || 4
sn17.30:1.5: Yā hissa sā Ānanda akuppā cetovimutti nāhaṃ tassa lābhasakkārasilokam antarāyāya vadāmi || || 5
sn17.30:1.6: Ye ca khvāssa Ānanda appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārādhigatā tesāhaṃ assa lābhasakkārasilokam antarāyāya vadāmi || || 6
sn17.30:1.7: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho Ānanda lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya || || 7
sn17.30:1.9: uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittam pariyādāya ṭhassatīti || || 8
